title: MemoryRecallRequest
description: Authorized, ranked, budgeted read for execution-time context (MEM-R011). Authorization filters first (MEM-R006), then provider ranking, then budget; truncated is true whenever the budget cut the authorized set. Candidates and tombstoned records never appear (MEM-R004). Grant: recall covering the selection. Read-only; the response payload is returned directly (§7.0.2).

filter.description: Optional provenance filter; combines with selection by AND.

query.description: Optional ranking hint only; never an authorization input.

max_items.description: Required; at least 1 and at most max_page_size.

budget.description: §9 budget applied after authorization and ranking.
budget.title: Budget

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor bound to principal, space, subject, selection/filter, snapshot marker and engine_policy_version. Any state or grant change invalidates it with CURSOR_INVALID (§7.0.7, MEM-R026).
cursor.title: Cursor
